title: Application database role separation
objective: Detect an app login that can update user roles or role-change records.
threshold: All four zero-row UPDATE probes must be denied by database privilege checks.
risks: Application credential can escalate roles or alter access-change evidence

title: Database-triggered role-change audit
objective: Detect a direct privileged update to a user role that fails to create an audit row.
threshold: A rollback-only direct role update creates exactly one matching audit row.
risks: Privileged database update changes access without leaving proof

title: Protected change and CI gate
objective: Verify main requires a pull request and six CI jobs, and the checked-out commit passed those jobs.
threshold: Pull request and all six required jobs enforced for admins; latest push run succeeds on the checked-out commit.
risks: Uncontrolled or untested change reaches the protected branch

title: Paper-account ledger integrity and reconciliation
objective: Detect changed ledger postings, unbalanced events, and cash or positions that differ from the ledger.
risks: Undetected alteration of paper-account balances or positions

title: Watchlist quote source-date freshness
objective: Detect missing or stale provider quotes for active hot-tier symbols.
threshold: Quote source date older than seven calendar days, or missing.
risks: Stale reference prices presented as current market data

title: Audited trading halt
objective: Stop new paper trades and orders when an administrator activates the halt, while keeping a transition history.
threshold: Every state change has an ordered event with a named administrator and reason; new entries stop while halted.
risks: Paper trading continues during an operational halt

title: Paper-order reference price band
objective: Reject stock orders priced more than 20% from a usable reference quote and detect open orders that later breach the band.
threshold: Price outside 80-120% of a reference quote no older than seven calendar days, or an unusable quote.
risks: Erroneous paper orders executed at extreme prices

title: Stock concentration limit
objective: Reject a stock buy when holdings and open buy orders would exceed 50% of account equity in one symbol.
evidence: GitHub Actions backend job for the reviewed commit; operating sample pending
threshold: Projected single-stock exposure must not exceed 50% of account equity.

title: Trade-entry retry deduplication
objective: Prevent repeated order or direct-trade requests with the same user key from creating a second execution.
threshold: User/key uniqueness enforced and every committed request has a saved response.
risks: Duplicate paper trades after a network retry

title: Stock position-size limit
objective: Reject a stock buy when holdings and open buy orders would exceed the configured dollar cap for one symbol.
evidence: GitHub Actions backend job for the reviewed commit; operating sample pending
threshold: Projected single-stock exposure must not exceed $50,000 by default.
risks: Paper stock position exceeds its dollar cap

title: Secret scanning on repository changes
objective: Verify the Gitleaks CI job passed on the checked-out commit.
threshold: Gitleaks secrets job succeeds on the latest push run for the checked-out commit.
